title: Microsoft.Entra/applications/keyCredentials
description: A certificate credential (public X.509 certificate) of an application. The child name is the credential's displayName (1-90 characters), its stateless key; the certificate's SHA-1 thumbprint decides whether the live credential is the declared one. Written with PATCH /applications/{id} of the whole keyCredentials collection (Graph has no single-certificate add without proof of possession): the credentials EARM does not manage are always sent back unchanged. Private keys are never handled.

displayName.description: Set from the resource name; declaring it is only allowed when it equals the name.

key.description: Required: the public certificate, base64 DER (Convert.ToBase64String of a .cer file) or a PEM CERTIFICATE block. A private key or a PFX is refused. A securestring parameter (for example a Key Vault reference in the parameter file) is accepted; its thumbprint is then masked in what-if.

type.description: Credential type; only AsymmetricX509Cert (a public certificate) is supported. Defaults to AsymmetricX509Cert.

usage.description: Purpose of the key. Defaults to Verify (application authentication with a certificate). Sign is refused at plan time: Graph pairs it with X509CertAndPassword, which carries the private key.

startDateTime.description: Start of validity (ISO 8601, UTC); Graph defaults it from the certificate. Compared only when declared.

endDateTime.description: Expiry (ISO 8601, UTC); Graph defaults it from the certificate. Compared only when declared.
